_comment: Character model sheets for the drawn series, fetched into the repo by .github/workflows/content-utils.yml, task `manhua-art-fetch`. These are not panels — nothing in the app loads them. They live here so that every future episode can attach the SAME reference image for a character, which is the only thing keeping a character the same person across episodes (docs/STORY-BIBLE.md §6). The two Inkbound sheets already in data/manhua/bible/ were committed by hand before this manifest existed.
_style_comment: 林老师 got a sheet late, and for a reason worth keeping: episode 3 gave him four panels, and generating them against a single episode-2 panel produced three visibly different men — a topknot in one, a modern crop in another, a straw hat in a third. The sheet is a reconciliation of episode 2's two teacher panels into one canonical face, and all four episode-3 panels were regenerated against it. 小美 with 花花, and 妈妈 with the quiet man, were drawn as sheets from the start for the same reason.
